purpose: Curated visual authority for Rex Fleet sequential comic production. Released Issue 1 story pages are the visual baseline; page 1 editorial material and covers are excluded from story-page style authority.

rules: Released Issue 1 story pages 2–19 control established identity, faction/world design, palette, lettering and comic-page language.
Select the actual released page that visibly anchors each recurring element; never infer a character-to-page mapping from retired production IDs.
Approved production pages may establish newer story state but do not redesign unchanged released identity.
Rejected, failed, repeated, superseded, promotional or chat-only generations are not visual authority.
